info.bio:
Gwen Renée Stefani (nació el 3 de octubre de 1969) es una cantautora, diseñadora de moda y, ocasionalmente, actriz. Llegó a la fama mientras estuvo en el grupo No Doubt, donde su música se vio influenciada por ritmos como el rock, y el ska.

Originaria de Anaheim, California, su hermano (ahora dibujante de Los Simpsons) la integró al grupo No Doubt, despues del suicidio del vocalista, Gwen pasó a ser la vocalista principal del grupo. Adquirió fama con el lanzamiento del álbum titulado Tragic Kingdom ('Reino Trágico') lanzado en 1995

podcast.title: Marriage to Gavin Rossdale (2002-2015)
podcast.body: Gwen Stefani married Gavin Rossdale of Bush in 2002. They had children together but were never members of the same band. Their marriage ended in 2015. "Then we have Gwen and Gavin Rossdale of Bush married in 2002, split in 2015. They have children but were never in the same band together."

podcast.title: Solo Career and Philanthropy
podcast.body: In addition to selling over 35 million records with No Doubt, Gwen Stefani sold millions more as a solo artist. She raised millions of dollars for child victims of the 2011 tsunami in Japan and supports various LGBT organizations and causes. "She sold over 35 million records with no doubt and millions more as a solo artist. She's raised millions of dollars for child victims of the 2011 tsunami in Japan. She supports various LGBT organizations and causes."

xref.title: Relationship, Breakup, and Band Success
xref.body: Gwen Stefani and Tony Canal of No Doubt were in a romantic relationship that eventually ended. Despite their breakup, they successfully continued as bandmates through the band's most successful period in the 1980s. "Gwen Stefani and Tony Canal from No Doubt, they were in a relationship but then broke up, yet were able to hold it together as the band went through their most successful period back in the 1980s."
